draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for the straight answer — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield fits your team. I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that often helps while you're evaluating: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real workflow in Wrenfield tends to answer the question faster than poking around. If it's useful, I'm happy to spend 15 minutes with you and your teammate this week setting that up with your own work.

Otherwise, I'll check back after your week.

Best,
Nadia
